chunks.l2:
[tal-a02-v01] Now the first word, of unceasing highest-recognition-nature: to determine it, this second treatise I begin.

[tal-a02-v10] Awareness-principle, 'self-luminous' — in this, what? Now, by reasoning: in its absence, would the universe be non-shining from inertia?

[tal-a02-v02] For the means-less, whose nature: what point by teaching here? Once may teaching be; afterwards as means-less it is called.

[tal-a02-v03] This means-less reality — whence without means? By itself; but of them that such: what should we say, indeed, to them?

[tal-a02-v04] Which fourfold-told form of awareness — of the pervading, this: own nature alone is to be regarded; for ever-arisen is the pervading.

[tal-a02-v05] By so many uncounted natures it shines; some part-by-part, others enter partlessly through that.

[tal-a02-v06] There too, from means-and-the-rest-expecting otherness-yoga, of means too not to be barred: variety from its otherness.

[tal-a02-v07] There, who pure-souled, in Bhairavī, own awareness, means-less practicing: whose rule — is proclaimed.

[tal-a02-v08] There, for now, rite-yoga does not deserve means-hood; for from that arisen, rather it is distinctly discerned.

[tal-a02-v09] In awareness, means just would be — quoted; if awareness is called: luminosity in self-luminous — and that, thence, from another — how?
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-:C2 atha śrītantrālokasya dvitīyamāhnikam yattatrādyaṃ padamaviratānuttarajñaptirūpaṃ / tannirṇetuṃ prakaraṇamidamārabhe@haṃ dvitīyam anupāyaṃ hi yadrūpaṃ ko@rtho deśanayātra vai / sakṛtsyāddeśanā paścādanupāyatvamucyayate anupāyamidaṃ tattvamityupāyaṃ vinā kutaḥ / svayaṃ tu teṣāṃ tattādṛk kiṃ brūmaḥ kila tānprati yaccaturdhoditaṃ rūpaṃ vijñānasya vibhorasau / svabhāva eva mantavyaḥ sa hi nityodito vibhuḥ etāvadbhirasaṃkhyātaiḥ svabhāvairyatprakāśate / ke@pyaṃśāṃśikayā tena viśantyanye niraṃśataḥ tatrāpi cābhyupāyādisāpekṣānyatvayogataḥ / upāyasyāpi no vāryā tadanyatvādvicitratā tatra ye nirmalātmāno bhairavīyāṃ svasaṃvidam / nirupāyāmupāsīnāstadvidhiḥ praṇigadyate tatra tāvatkriyāyogo nābhyupāyatvamarhati / sa hi tasmātsamudbhūtaḥ pratyuta pravibhāvyate jñaptāvupāya eva syāditi cejjñaptirucyate / prakāśatvaṃ svaprakāśe tacca tatrānyataḥ katham saṃvittattvaṃ svaprakāśamityasminkaṃ nu yuktibhiḥ / tadabhāve bhavedviśvaṃ jaḍatvādaprakāśakam

chunks.l2:
[tal-a02-v11] Whatever means, outer, would be, or inner, whatsoever: it, all face-turned-to-it; there, means-bearing — how?

[tal-a02-v12] Abandon attentions, now: where, indeed, do you place attention? Discern yourself, it: in the full, attention — not, for, indeed fitting; the unfull does not attain, and, the true nature.

[tal-a02-v13] By that attention-vital of this, meditation-and-the-rest, on the higher path, in the Bhairavī: how indeed would there be direct means-ness?

[tal-a02-v14] Whoever even by direct means that nature discern: surely they, for sun-awareness, firefly-desiring, are dullards.

[tal-a02-v15] And, as long as this outer — inner-means-deemed: that mere luminous-natured alone, Śiva's own form.

[tal-a02-v16] Blue, yellow, 'pleasure': luminance alone is Śiva; in this supreme nonduality, luminous-natured: what other?

[tal-a02-v17] Means-to-be-attained-relation would be luminance alone — for it.

[tal-a02-v18] This — duality indeed — this, difference: this nonduality, thus, even, in the luminous form alone — this shines, the Supreme Lord.

[tal-a02-v19] In this level, pleasure, pain, bondage, release — whether conscious or inert: like pot-and-jar, same-meaning words — of them even just one — and.

[tal-a02-v20] In the shining-forth, for an unlit part, how, indeed, radiance? In the shining, in that or, that duality of it obliterated.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-yāvānupāyo bāhyaḥ syādāntaro vāpi kaścana / sa sarvastanmukhaprekṣī tatropāyatvabhākkatham tyajāvadhānāni nanu kva nāma dhatse@vadhānaṃ vicinu svayaṃ tat / pūrṇe@vadhānaṃ na hi nāma yuktaṃ nāpūrṇamabhyeti ca satyabhāvam tenāvadhānaprāṇasya bhāvanādeḥ pare pathi / bhairavīye kathaṃkāraṃ bhavetsākṣādupāyatā ye@pi sākṣādupāyena tadrūpaṃ praviviñcate / nūnaṃ te sūryasaṃvittyai khadyotādhitsavo jaḍāḥ kiṃ ca yāvadidaṃ bāhyamāntaropāyasaṃmatam / tatprakāśātmatāmātraṃ śivasyaiva nijaṃ vapuḥ nīlaṃ pītaṃ sukhamiti prakāśaḥ kevalaḥ śivaḥ / amuṣminparamādvaite prakāśātmani ko@paraḥ upāyopeyabhāvaḥ syātprakāśaḥ kevalaṃ hi saḥ idaṃ dvaitama@yaṃ bheda idamadvaitamityapi / prakāśavapurevāyaṃ bhāsate parameśvaraḥ asyāṃ bhūmau sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bandho mokṣaścitarjaḍaḥ / ghaṭakumbhavadekārthāḥ śabdāste@pyekameva ca praśāśe hyaprakāśāṃśaḥ kathaṃ nāma prakāśatām / prakāśamāne tasminvā taddvaitāstasya lopitāḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a02-v21] In non-shining, then, in that or: reality, how is it said? Not luminance-specificity unapproved, indeed it follows.

[tal-a02-v22] Hence, 'one luminance' — thus, in the doctrine here, well-established: from afar warded off, truly, the different-knowledge-sayers.

[tal-a02-v23] Mere luminance taught through non-shining-denial: of the word 'one', not — but the meaning: is number, bearing consciousness-manifest-difference.

[tal-a02-v24] Not this: śakti, the great goddess; not resting on another, since; nor, and this: śakti-possessing god; not of anyone a resort, since.

[tal-a02-v25] Not this: the meditated, from meditator-hood, not: the meditator, from meditated-absence; no worshipful, from worshipper-absence, from worshipful-absence: no worshipper.

[tal-a02-v26] Not mantra, nor; and mantra-able, this; not, and the pronouncer, the Lord; no initiation, initiator, or even; no initiated one, the Great Lord.

[tal-a02-v27] Place-seat-restraint-offering-mass-invocation-and-the-rest, ending in dismissal: there is not here, in doer-deed-act-abandoned.

[tal-a02-v28] Not being, not not-being, being, not-being: and that, not both-abandoned: hard to know, for, that state: some, whatever, this unsurpassed.

[tal-a02-v29] 'This' — thus appearance, for which, being of cut-off nature: it, just, pot-like in the world, situated then: not this is Bhairava.

[tal-a02-v30] Non-being, and non-shining, not: anywhere usefulness; of the universe, is the life, truly, luminance-natured-alone, and it.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-aprakāśe@tha tasminvā vastutā kathamucyate / na prakāśaviśeṣatvamata evopapadyate ata ekaprakāśo@yamiti vāde@tra susthite / dūrādāvāritāḥ satyaṃ vibhinnajñānavādinaḥ prakāśamātramuditamaprakāśaniṣedhanāt / ekaśabdasya na tvarthaḥ saṃkhyā cidvyaktibhedabhāk naiṣa śaktirmahādevī na paratrāśrito yataḥ / na caiṣa śaktimāndevo na kasyāpyāśrayo yataḥ naiṣa dhyeyo dhyātrabhāvānna dhyātā dhyeyavarjanāt / na pūjyaḥ pūjakābhāvātpūjyābhāvānna pūjakaḥ na mantro na ca mantryo@sau na ca mantrayitā prabhuḥ / na dīkṣā dīkṣako vāpi na dīkṣāvānmaheśvaraḥ sthānāsananirodhārghasaṃghānāvāhanādikam / visarjanāntaṃ nāstyatra kartṛkarmakriyojjhite na sanna cāsatsadasanna ca tannobhayojjhitam / durvijñeyā hi sāvasthā kimapyetadanuttaram ayamityavabhāso hi yo bhāvo@vacchidātmakaḥ / sa eva ghaṭavalloke saṃstathā naiṣa bhairavaḥ asattvaṃ cāprakāśatvaṃ na kutrāpyupayogitā / viśvasya jīvitaṃ satyaṃ prakāśaikātmakaśca saḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a02-v31] By these two just, but from causes: not two-natured, nor two-abandoned; wholly, for, shines it: by what form, let it be mantred?

[tal-a02-v32] In the venerable Triśiras, told, supreme-knowledge-nature, by śakti dwelling within the womb, śakti-wombed, supreme state.

[tal-a02-v33] Neither being, nor non-being, nor the pair: by unsayable speech, unsayable-word-escalated, śakti-dwelling, śakti-devoid.

[tal-a02-v34] Thus, who rooted-knowledge-truth-purified, on the anuttara path, rooted: they, means-unruled.

[tal-a02-v35] Of them, this, shines together, everywhere, the being-circle, standing-forth just, melted in consciousness-Bhairava-fire.

[tal-a02-v36] Of these, pleasure-pain-share-doubt-fear-notions, nirvikalpa-entry-only-remainder come to.

[tal-a02-v37] Of these, no mantra, no meditation, no worship, nor even imagination: no, from samayin to ācārya, anyone, is a resting-place.

[tal-a02-v38] All-restraint-system-break-marks-bearing, not than grace beyond, in any remaining conduct, is the purpose.

[tal-a02-v39] Own, to be done, whatever, considering the world, this, from effort, not, for others' sake, toward, joins, any own activity, but if, whose every existence-stain is destroyed, full of Bhairavī-nature: the deed, his, clearly this just this-much world-duty merely.

[tal-a02-v40] Him, who see, by that-form-order, stainless-aware, they too, of his form, so much, just, of him, grace-naturedness.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-ābhyāmeva tu hetubhyāṃ na dvyātmā na dvayojjhitaḥ / sarvātmanā hi bhātyeṣa kena rūpeṇa mantryatām śrīmattriśirasi proktaṃ parajñānasvarūpakam / śaktyā garbhāntarvartinyā śaktigarbha paraṃ padam na bhāvo nāpyabhāvo na dvayaṃ vācāmagocarāt / akathyapadavīrūḍhaṃ śaktisthaṃ śaktivarjitam iti ye rūḍhasaṃvittiparamārthapavitritāḥ / anuttarapathe rūḍhāste@bhyupāyāniyantritāḥ teṣāmidaṃ samābhāti sarvato bhāvamaṇḍalam / puraḥsthameva saṃvittibhairavāgnivilāpitam eteṣāṃ sukhaduḥkhāṃśaśaṃkātaṃkavikalpanāḥ / nirvikalpaparāveśamātraśeṣatvamāgatāḥ eṣāṃ na mantro na dhyānaṃ na pūjā nāpi kalpanā / na samayyādikācāryaparyantaḥ ko@pi viśramaḥ samastayantraṇātantratroṭanāṭaṃkadharmiṇaḥ / nānugrahātparaṃ kiṃciccheṣavṛttau prayojanam svaṃ kartavyaṃ kimapi kalayaṃlloka eṣa prayatnānno pārārthyaṃ prati ghaṭayate kāṃcana svapravṛttim / yastu dhvastākhilabhavamalo bhairavībhāvapūrṇaḥ kṛtyaṃ tasya sphuṭamidamiyallokakartavyamātram taṃ ye paśyanti tādrūpyakrameṇāmalasaṃvidaḥ / te@pi tadrūpiṇastāvatyevāsyānugrahātmatā

chunks.l2:
[tal-a02-v41] This tattva-recognition is chief, sacrifice-and-the-rest is called, up to initiation, by the Lord, in the Siddhayogīśvarī doctrine.

[tal-a02-v42] From the altar, the higher, loom, from the loom northward, the cloth, from cloth, meditation, then, the to-be-meditated, then, should be dhāraṇā higher.

[tal-a02-v43] Then too, yoga-born, form, then too, knowledge higher, by knowledge, for, greatly accomplished, should become a Yogīśvara — but, quoted.

[tal-a02-v44] He too, through freedom-abode, if even of the impure-aware, grace, desiring to grace that forthcoming one, he should resort to the rite.

[tal-a02-v45] According to the graced one, varied, it, and, is taught, through Parāparā-and-the-rest-means-flood-mixedness-division.

[tal-a02-v46] For that purpose alone, and of him too, of the Lord-formed one, that means-scripture-and-the-rest-hearing-studying-zeal.

[tal-a02-v47] For not, of him, of the free, anywhere, wherever, is refutation, not of the impure-minded, of man, grace, but meanslessness.

[tal-a02-v48] In the venerable Ūrmi great-scripture, Siddha-lineage-shaped: this told, so, by the venerable Somānanda and the teachers.

[tal-a02-v49] From the guru's word-and-the-rest, from wiping by heaped reasoning, from assurance — the śāstra, toward, from the arisen, or even, from the told: when dissolved, in the doubt-cloud, that heart-sky-shining-greatness, of the Lord, sun-like, touching, feet darkness-conquering.

[tal-a02-v50] This anuttara-abode-discerning, means-shed, made: the ahnika.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-etattattvaparijñānaṃ mukhyaṃ yāgādi kathyate / dīkṣāntaṃ vibhunā śrīmatsiddhayogīśvarīmate sthaṇḍilāduttaraṃ tūraṃ tūrāduttarataḥ paṭaḥ / paṭāddhyānaṃ tato dhyeyaṃ tataḥ syāddhāraṇottarā tato@pi yogajaṃ rūpaṃ tato@pi jñānamuttaram / jñānena hi mahāsiddho bhavedyogīśvarastviti so@pi svātantryadhāmnā cedapyanirmalasaṃvidām / anugrahaṃ cikīrṣustadbhāvinaṃ vidhimāśrayet anugrāhyānusāreṇa vicitraḥ sa ca kathyate / parāparādyupāyaughasaṃkīrṇatvavibhedataḥ tadarthameva cāsyāpi parameśvararūpiṇaḥ / tadabhyupāyaśāstrādiśravaṇādhyayanādaraḥ nahi tasya svatantrasya kāpi kutrāpi khaṇḍanā / nānirmalacitaḥ puṃso@nugrahastvanupāyakaḥ śrīmadūrmimahāśāstre siddhasaṃtānarūpake / idamuktaṃ tathā śrīmatsomānandādidaiśikaiḥ gurorvākyādyuktipracayaracanonmārjanavaśāt samāśvāsācchāstraṃ prati samuditādvāpi kathitāt / vilīne śaṃkābhre tdṛdayagaganodbhāsimahasaḥ prabhoḥ sūryasyeva spṛśata caraṇāndhvāntajayinaḥ idamanuttaradhāmavivecakaṃ vigalitaupayikaṃ kṛtamāhnikam
